narrative: Kamji Gond (42) died in custody after being allegedly assaulted by police at Revati police station. An FIR was filed by his son Vishal Gond against sub-inspector Sachin Saroj, constable Ankit Singh, and others under BNS provisions related to murder. The victim was reportedly taken from his home while asleep, assaulted inside the police station under pressure from a village head, further assaulted at a brick kiln, and abandoned in an orchard. SI Sachin Saroj and Constable Ankit Singh were suspended. SHO Raj Keshar Singh was transferred to police lines. A magisterial inquiry was ordered.
status_detail: SI Sachin Saroj and constable Ankit Singh suspended. SHO Raj Keshar Singh transferred. Magisterial inquiry ordered by district administration.
